support1:
I started by building FitoMatic, a fitness platform I ran on my own for 2.5 years. I did everything from product to sales, and closed 100+ deals along the way. Then came years of B2B SaaS sales at Cybrilla, and growth work with companies like Perccent, FinArk and MFStack.

The work has always circled the same question: how do we get more customers, more sales and more revenue?

Today, I help SaaS and WealthTech founders answer it. I find where they’re losing customers, and fix it with their team.
support2: Outside work, I make time for slow walks with my people, reading books at cafes, and sitting in silence.
